title: fix: reject image input for text-only models
author: danhquach
pr_body_excerpt:
Fixes #15684

- Returns 400 `This model does not support image input` when a request carries `image_url`/`input_image` and the model's `inputModalities` lacks `image`, on `/v1/chat/completions` and `/v1/responses`. Reuses `countReferenceImages` in `textCapabilityError`.
- Skips community agents: prompt agents pass images to their base model through gen, where the check runs again; code and endpoint agents run their owner's code.
- Adds `image` to `pollinations/midijourney`, `pollinations/midijourney-large` and `qwen/qwen3.8-2.4t-a95b`, which already read images (probes below).
- Tests: a text-only community proxy returns 400 on both routes without calling upstream; a vision proxy and an endpoint agent are still served; unit coverage for static text-only vs vision models.

**Live probes** (64×64 solid PNG, "What color is this image? One word.")

| Model | Result |
|---|---|
| `community/MarcosFRG/deepseek-v4-flash-0731` | "White" for green, 9 prompt tokens: image dropped |
| `meta/llama-3.3-70b-instruct`, `openai/gpt-oss-20b` | same prompt tokens with/without image: dropped |
| `qwen/qwen3-coder-30b-a3b-instruct`, `z-ai/glm-5.3`, `amazon/nova-micro-v1` +4 more | provider 400/405 |
| `pollinations/midijourney` | green→"green", blue→"blue": sees images |
| `qwen/qwen3.8-2.4t-a95b` | green→"Green", blue→"Blue": sees images |
| `pollinations/midijourney-large` | +5 prompt tokens with image; same GPT-5.5 deployment as `openai/gpt-5.5` |
| `openai/gpt-5.4-nano` (control) | "Green", 64 prompt tokens |

PII/secret gate: passed (security-devops audit of `origin/main..HEAD`, commit message, and PR body).

gist.headline: No more invisible pictures
gist.blurb: Text-only models now say when they can’t see an image instead of quietly pretending it wasn’t there. Models that can see still get the pixels.
gist.summary: On /v1/chat/completions and /v1/responses, requests containing image_url or input_image now receive a 400 error when the selected model lacks image input support; Midijourney, Midijourney Large, and Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B are correctly marked as image-capable.
gist.impact: Developers get a clear “This model does not support image input” response instead of a text-only model silently dropping the image, while supported vision models continue to receive it.
